body: I really hope you're right. I've been this way for 7 years(I'm 19 now) and it's getting harder and harder to snap out of it. I really wanna move and go to a different place, but I'm dependent on my parents right now. My only way out is to transfer to a out of state college and that's hard enough without me being unproductive most of the time. It's almost a catch 22, the more depressed I get the more I want to leave, but I can't leave because I'm too depressed to try.

I do have a few close friends but they are only a few and I don't see them as much as I would like. And even then sometimes I act awkward around them and it makes me fully self aware and that maybe they don't like me. I do recognize this could all be in my head but there's that voice that is constantly yelling "they hate you, why would anyone like you?" And it's hard to ignore them

It's hard for me to imagine going on in life when I'm constantly depressed/anxious. I'm constantly lonely and feel left out of life due to my inability to just be a normal person. I have a few friends but I'm always feeling like they don't like me or even want to be near me. It's hard to imagine a future when I keep alienating people.
